newsitem.title: UK: DMG UK pension head Horlick resigns.
newsitem.headline: DMG UK pension head Horlick resigns.

text.p: Nicola Horlick, head of British pension fund business at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell's Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, has resigned, her spokesman told Reuters on Thursday.
The spokesman said Horlick was planning to take legal action against her former employer over what she called her "constructive dismissal" by the investment bank.
"She has resigned," a spokesman for Horlick said. "She will be taking (legal) action against DMG."
A Deutsche Morgan Grenfell official separately confirmed to Reuters on Thursday that Horlick had resigned.
Horlick was suspended on Tuesday pending the outcome of an internal investigation into what Deutsche Morgan Grenfell described as "a potential breach of her contract".

Horlick, a mother of five, was said by British newspapers to earn one million pounds ($1.68 million) a year. Her suspension immediately prompted disquiet among large pension fund clients of Morgan Grenfell Asset Management.
